This is an application filed under Section 430(1) of the Bharathiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023,
seeking suspension of sentence of the applicant/2nd accused in S.C. No.961 of 2018 on the file of the Court of Session, Ernakulam.

The applicant/2nd accused has been found guilty for the offence punishable under Section 420 read with Section 34 IPC and hence has been sentenced to simple imprisonment for three years and to a fine of 5,50,000/-.

opennyai_summary.decision:
This is an application filed under Section 430(1) of the Bharathiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023,
seeking suspension of sentence of the applicant/2nd accused in S.C. No.961 of 2018 on the file of the Court of Session, Ernakulam.
The applicant/2nd accused has been found guilty for the offence punishable under Section 420 read with Section 34 IPC and hence has been sentenced to simple imprisonment for three years and to a fine of 5,50,000/-.
The sentence imposed on the applicant/2 nd accused is suspended till the disposal of the appeal subject to the following conditions:-
i) The applicant/2nd accused shall be released on bail on executing a bond for 50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the trial court;
ii) Out of the fine amount, she shall deposit an amount of 1,00,000/- within a period of one month from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
iii) She shall not commit any offence(s) while on bail;
iv) If the conviction and sentence of the applicant/ 2nd accused is upheld or even modified, the time during which she is so released shall be excluded in computing the term of her sentence as provided in Section 430(4) BNSS.
v) It is also made clear that if any of the conditions are violated, the bail shall stand cancelled.
